summary: Acer Aspire 5 14 is a suitable laptop for League of Legends gaming and college use, offering a balance between performance and budget. It features a 14-inch screen, Intel Core i3 processor, 8GB RAM, and NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 graphics.
detected_fault: The user is looking for a laptop that can handle League of Legends gaming at medium-high settings (1080p or higher) and also be suitable for general college tasks.
suggested_solution: Consider laptops with Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 processors, 8GB RAM, and NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 graphics to provide better gaming performance.
